about: Whether a text is a usable sign-in spec for a phone reading format 3 (mazama_modules/SPEC.md "A usable sign-in spec"). Run by mazama_sales/tests/state/test_login_spec_source.py (login_spec_source.usable) and mazama_mobile/test/login_spec_store_test.dart (usableLoginSpec); both must give every answer. A case with "served" ("login" or "browser") is asked in that served mode (SL-R19: served at /p/flows/login, no open_browser; at /p/flows/login_browser, an open_browser in login); a case without it in none.

cases.name: good
cases.why: the reference spec: every rule met
cases.yaml:
format: 1
vars:
  spec_version: "2026-10-24.3"
  timeout_seconds: 60
  refresh_margin_seconds: 120
  tenant: oregonpsilocybinprodb2c
  b2c: "https://{{tenant}}.b2clogin.com/{{tenant}}.onmicrosoft.com"
flows:
  login:
    - id: ids
      type: generate
      make: random_hex
      into: [state]
    - id: page
      type: request
      method: GET
      url: "{{b2c}}/authorize"
      params: {state: "{{state}}"}
      extract:
        - {var: csrf, source: body, regex: '"csrf":"([^"]+)"'}
    - id: form
      type: request
      method: POST
      url: "{{b2c}}/SelfAsserted"
      headers: {X-CSRF-TOKEN: "{{csrf}}"}
      form: {email: "{{email}}", password: "{{password}}"}
      require:
        - check: status_in
          values: [200]
          reason: unavailable
          error: "refused: {{why}} (HTTP {status})"
      capture_on_fail:
        - {var: why, source: body, json: message, default: "no reason"}
    - id: token
      type: request
      method: POST
      url: "{{b2c}}/token"
      form: {code: "{{csrf}}"}
      extract:
        - {var: access_token, source: body, json: access_token}
        - {var: refresh_token, source: body, json: refresh_token}
      then_require:
        - check: json_equals
          path: token_type
          value: "{{access_token}}"
          reason: structure
          error: "no token"
  renew:
    - id: token
      type: request
      method: POST
      url: "{{b2c}}/token"
      form: {grant_type: refresh_token, refresh_token: "{{refresh_token}}"}
      extract:
        - {var: access_token, source: body, json: access_token}

  timeout_seconds: 60
  refresh_margin_seconds: 120
  tenant: oregonpsilocybinprodb2c
  b2c: "https://{{tenant}}.b2clogin.com/{{tenant}}.onmicrosoft.com"

flows:

    - id: ids
      type: generate
      make: random_hex
      into: [state]
    - id: page
      type: open_browser
      url: "{{b2c}}/authorize"
      params: {state: "{{state}}"}
      until: "{{site}}"
      extract:
        - {var: code, source: url_fragment, name: code}
        - {var: returned_state, source: url_fragment, name: state}

    - id: token

      form: {code: "{{code}}"}
      extract:
        - {var: access_token, source: body, json: access_token}

    - id: token
      type: request
      method: POST
      url: "{{b2c}}/token"

      extract:
